A.name: Storybook Quest
A.line: The Primary Advantage look for small children: a bright painted adventure world, a game bar of growing plants, and a blue title plaque with crystals.

B.name: Picture-book Trail
B.line: The Reading Advantage look made soft: a hand-painted picture-book garden, a wooden game bar, and a wooden title sign with gold edges and a blue ribbon.

C.name: Sticker Map
C.line: A flat, bold game-map look: bright flat colors, a path past the things of the unit, white sticker frames, and big round title labels that a child reads from far away.
